name: PlayInfo
description: Admin playback session monitor displaying active streams, play state, and real-time transcode telemetry.
overview: Admin playback session monitor displaying active streams, play state, and real-time transcode telemetry.

versions.changelog: Release v0.2.7.0 - Unified the Now Playing dashboard widget with Connected Devices (shared glass/accent-ring styling, tinted by real playback method). Fixed the session grid leaving dead space with fewer active streams than columns. Poster art no longer stretches into a cropped sliver once Extended/Show Details makes a card taller. Compact mode now also shows bitrate, frame rate, and subtitle-active pills, a progress-completion ring on the poster, and real-world elapsed watch time next to ETA. The transcode reason is now a consistent highlighted callout in both Compact and Extended. The Info toggle can independently collapse one card while others stay open under Show Details, with a proper rotating chevron. Show Details is now grouped into titled Playback/Video/Audio/Stream/Subtitles sections. Fixed a bug where a malformed Discord webhook or Telegram bot token could block saving the notification enable switches entirely. Added delivery logging for successful Discord/Telegram sends to aid future diagnosis.

Release v0.2.6.0 - Rebrand from Playback Info Card to PlayInfo (new icon/banner, renamed everywhere in the live UI, not just the plugin name). Tautulli-style card redesign: poster art now bleeds flush to the card's edge and spans its full height instead of a small inset thumbnail, the blurred backdrop art is actually visible, and each card carries a colored status ring (green/blue/purple/red) matching its real playback method. New admin-only session controls: Send Message and Stop, calling Jellyfin's own native Session API, with a custom confirm dialog styled to match the card instead of a bare OS popup. Real Moonfin brand icon replacing the placeholder crescent. Relicensed from MIT to GPL-3.0, matching Tautulli.

Release v0.2.5.4 - Broadened client/device icon coverage: macOS and Linux sessions (previously falling through to the generic icon), non-Android smart TVs (Vizio, Hisense, and other VIDAA/SmartCast devices), and two more real third-party clients (Fladder, Jellyfin MPV Shim). Same resolver logic and icon set on both the dashboard widget and the standalone Playback Monitor page.

Release v0.2.5.3 - Merged the two sidebar entries (Playback Monitor / My Playback) into one: admins see every active session, non-admin users see only their own, decided by role instead of registering the same page twice. The dashboard widget's Info button no longer opens a slide-out side panel -- it now expands the same full field grid inline on that card, tracked by session ID so it survives polling, matching how the standalone page already worked and restoring the original in-card design.

Release v0.2.5.2 - Prominent summary strip above the grid shows total active streams plus a genuine Direct/Transcoding split (correctly counts a paused Transcode session as Transcoding, not silently dropped). High-signal pills (resolution, dynamic range, audio, subtitle) now carry a leading icon so they scan at a glance; codec/bit-depth/container pills stay icon-free. The progress bar moves from the card footer to directly under the title for better visual hierarchy. Deeper "liquid glass" treatment (backdrop blur, saturation boost, specular highlight, bright/dim edge split) applied consistently across the card, badges, pills, chips, and Info drawer on both the dashboard widget and the standalone My Playback page.

Release v0.2.5.1 - Standalone My Playback page brought to full parity with the dashboard widget (Info-panel persistence fix, ETA/Atmos/audio-language/subtitle-method/avatar additions, matching artwork/badge/transcode-reason logic), removal of a dead MVC controller superseded by the dashboard middleware, and added test coverage for the notification delivery service's safe-degradation behavior when the plugin has not yet initialized.
